summary: Use search, dependency inspection and executable verification to diagnose the change boundary before restructuring code.

items.text: Search for declarations, call sites, command invocations and tests; record the set actually inspected for a representative change rather than loading the entire file by default.
Use language-server references or static call graphs to find the dependency closure around a proposed component boundary; inspect dynamic dispatch and runtime configuration separately.
Run the existing build and behavior tests before and after extraction; add a focused characterization test only when a behavior has no executable check.
Track task completion, erroneous edits, context read, tool calls, review time and cost across the same tasks and model–harness pair.
